title: Chapter 77 Attacking The Supply Line (Part 2)
content:
Chapter 77 Attacking The Supply Line (Part 2)

"Yu Chong, take your tribesmen to help!"

"We need to attack faster! The evil god army behind us will soon gather, and the Zerg can't stop them for too long!"

Meng saw the battle situation behind him and turned to Yu Chong.

"Okay! Watch us!"

Yu Chong led the Yu tribe archers and rushed to the back of the dogs in front, using precise archery skills to help the Zerg dogs kill the enemy quickly.

The arrows are slender and can carry a large number. In addition, they are all cavalry, and their mounts can carry a lot of extra arrows, which is enough for them to fight several battles.

Meng was right. More and more enemy reinforcements came from the direction of the evil god camp, and soon they gathered into multiple square formations and launched a siege on the Zerg.

The Zerg, with two thousand hydralisks as the core, continued to fight a war of attrition with the evil god army, and took advantage of the speed advantage to fight and retreat, buying time for the alliance army in another direction.

On the other side of the supply road, the transport team of the evil god camp, which was farther away, began to retreat on their own initiative, and quickly formed a simple defensive position in cooperation with the defense troops.

The Zerg puppies and the Feather Clan archers cleared the entire supply road and rushed to the front of this temporary simple defensive position.

Because of the time being too hasty, this simple defensive position did not even have time to put the transport materials in front of the formation, and the puppies rushed into the position.

"Brothers! It's our turn!"

"Ready! Volley!"

Meng shouted the order and rushed to the front of the team, throwing the javelin in his hand far away.

Three thousand javelin and one thousand hand axes instantly smashed the simple defensive position of the evil god camp into pieces.

The puppies rushed up and completely dispersed the entire defensive position.

"Brothers! It's finally our turn to kill the enemy with our own hands!"

"Kill!"

Meng and Bai Yan took the lead, leading three thousand cavalry and one thousand heavy infantry, and rushed into the enemy position that had almost lost its ability to resist.

The sharp swords were waving, and the heads of the enemies rolled down. This most elite force in the alliance territory finally showed their powerful melee ability.

With just a charge, the largest enemy defense force blocking the front of the alliance army disappeared.

"Keep going! Don't stop!"

The Zerg puppies did not stop. They swept all the way and ate up everything they could eat.

Meng led the elite of the alliance and followed the puppies with murderous intent. The passionate close combat had completely aroused their fighting spirit.

Wu Qing also had ten Zerg heavy cavalrymen who had been following Meng. Once the battle started, he became a transparent man.

He and the ten Zergmen held longbows transformed from biological colonization suits in their hands. They used the super vision of the aerial host to check for loopholes and shoot those threatening enemy targets.

With Wu Qing's escort, none of the charging cavalry and heavy infantry were reduced.

Of course, this was also related to the relatively weak strength of the enemy.

After rushing through this temporary defense position, the front was full of transport teams that had no ability to resist. All the personnel who could fight among them had been eliminated in the temporary defense position.

Killing and destruction are the strengths of the Zerg. The puppies are like locusts passing through the border. After they pass, there is a mess behind them.

The troops behind them didn't even have a chance to make up.

After rushing for a long distance, the alliance army had left the Zerg troops that blocked the enemy in the rear far behind.

With no battle to fight for a while, he ran to Wu Qing and asked worriedly: "We are running so fast, don't we want the Zerg troops behind us?"

"Don't worry, they want to run, and the enemy can't stop them!"

"We have to run faster, there are a lot of cavalry chasing us from behind!"

"There is another big battle waiting for us in front, let's try to create a time difference and kill the enemies in front first!"

"After this battle, it's almost time. I hope you still have the energy to follow the Zerg and lead the enemy around!"

Wu Qing responded with a smile.

"Have we encountered a big fish ahead?"

"Wu Qing, I admire your ability to control battlefield intelligence! People are here, and control all directions!"

"I'll go prepare now!"

"Don't worry! We are full of energy!"

"Hahaha!"

Hearing that there was a battle to be fought, Meng laughed happily and ran to the front to command the troops.

The reason why Meng was so happy was that, first, he was indeed a crazy warmonger, and second, in such a battle, the loss of the territory was almost zero, but the luck gained was full, so he couldn't help being happy.

With luck, the territory can become stronger. Only when everyone's territory is strong can the alliance have a place in this chaotic world.

The enemy army around the Zerg responsible for blocking is gathering more and more, and the Hydralisk and the Zergling have begun to fight mobile warfare.

The Zerg took advantage of the Hydralisk's long-range attack advantage and fought and ran.

When the enemy is strong, the Hydralisk hits and runs away.

When the enemy is weak, the Hydralisk hits first, and then the Zerglings encircle and annihilate.

The Zerg's tactics brought the Zerg's advantages to the fullest, making the evil god's army dizzy.

They couldn't outrun them, and they couldn't fight them.

The more troops gathered together, the lowered their command and speed.

The scattered troops couldn't beat these terrible bugs.

This was the situation of the evil god's army at this time.

But the Zerg's advantage was only temporary. With the increase of elite troops coming to support from the evil god's camp, the Zerg's space for activities was being compressed.

The gathering cavalry was a huge threat, and the Zerg were ready to retreat at any time.

…

Not far in front of the Alliance army attacking eastward, there was a large transport team, escorted by tens of thousands of elite bear goblin infantry, advancing slowly.

Although the heavy interception of the puppies interrupted the information communication between the army and the front, the attack warning flares that flew into the sky from time to time still made the army alert.

The scouts sent by the bear goblin army kept fighting with the Zerg puppies lurking nearby, making the army realize the seriousness of the problem.

They slowed down their advance, the bear goblin infantry began to line up, the cavalry troops moved forward, and all the combat troops entered a state of alert and preparation.

A little further ahead, they finally saw the Alliance army that was frantically killing and destroying all the way.

"Stop advancing!"

"Stand in place!"

The mission of this army of bear goblins is to guard the huge transport team. Even though the Alliance army in front of them does not seem to be numerous, they dare not take the initiative to attack.

They stayed in place and let the Alliance army kill them all the way.

The ordinary personnel in the transport team on the supply road, although they are believers of the evil god, are not combat soldiers. If they encounter the enemy army, they do not need to fight to the death.

The personnel of these transport teams are now driven away by the puppies, and many have already fled the supply route area.

But their fate is already determined. There are still many lurking Zerg puppies waiting for them on the periphery of this battlefield, and none of them can escape.
